decidedFrom: 12 static pages: a home page, a project index, a resume, an NDA notice and 8 case studies of one designer's work
no pricing, sign-up, trial, account, dashboard or checkout anywhere in the source
the only conversions are contact links (email, professional profile) and requests for a private walkthrough
content is one person's work history, case studies and an about-me band

approval.proposedBy: agent (design-repo extraction); not ratified by the owner

generationRules.modes: PageSpec.mode is reference (faithful reconstruction, evidence only) or generated (a new page for someone else).
generated: no source person name, contact detail, employer, product/case-study name or URL (GENERATED_MODE_PERSON / BRAND / URL)
no verbatim source copy or source call-to-action labels (GENERATED_MODE_COPY / CTA; fingerprints in policy/source-brand.json)
no source wordmark, photographs, product screens or videos; only generation-safe asset roles with placeholder://, generated:// or user-supplied:// sources (GENERATED_MODE_LOGO / ASSET)
external links only on reserved placeholder domains (*.example, *.invalid, example.com/.org/.net)
always: node sequences match their template; copy within measured word budgets; tokens from the catalog under the token policy
runtime UI (menus, dialogs, lightboxes, hints, progress bars) is never retrievable
every motion pattern carries its pinned reduced-motion fallback

rules: the client-side password gate of locked projects is described as a mechanism only; its secret is never recorded or generated
Night is the default theme; Day is the alternate (both schema-validated)
long-form case studies are decomposed into chapter-level sections; no section may hold a whole case study
